title: Deed Of Separation Between Husband And Wife With A Trustee Wife To Have Custody Of Child
description: A deed of separation between husband and wife with a trustee wife to have custody of child used for matters related to marriage, divorce, custody, maintenance, or domestic relations. Suitable for spouses, parents, family members, or their legal counsel. Key details required: Date (First Party), Date (Second Party), Amount (Rs.) (First Party), Amount (Rs.) (Second Party), Date (Third Party).
description_hi: Deed Of Separation Between Husband And Wife With A Trustee Wife To Have Custody Of Child — विवाह, तलाक, अभिरक्षा, भरण-पोषण, या पारिवारिक संबंधों से संबंधित मामले के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला कानूनी प्रारूप। पति-पत्नी, माता-पिता, परिवार के सदस्य, या उनके कानूनी सलाहकार के लिए उपयुक्त। 7 आवश्यक और 2 वैकल्पिक विवरण भरने होंगे।
